perfBudget.status: DRAFT - starting targets, to be calibrated by the first S20 FE bench run
perfBudget.author: Boltverse Perf
perfBudget.device: SmiR's S20 FE only; render mode B (ratio 1.5 + EASU/RCAS sharpening)
rules: Triangles go where the eye is: the 0-60 m ring gets most of the budget; cut only hidden faces, off-screen geometry and extra far detail.
LOD swaps keep an identical silhouette (no pop, no morph); far ring is one ridge silhouette mesh.
Wake effects prefer emissive/material ramps over new dynamic lights; no shadow-casting point lights.
Budgets are per camera frame at each spine segment, including Bolt, wake FX and HUD.

global.sustain: 30 min continuous spine loop with no thermal throttle step and fps median >= 55

visibleTriangles.note: Settled 2026-10-13 by Engine Core + Perf: 600k typical / 850k peak is the whole frame; the 150k figure is the ground sub-budget (0-60 m chunks + rings + far mesh). Object LOD0 budgets come out of the rest.

global.postFx: bloom at half resolution; film grade single pass

segments.note: basin reveal at s=40 sees the whole basin plus Frostspire: far-ring and mid-ring LODs carry it, not near detail
curtain glow is an emissive ramp on the curtain material; occluder culls the basin while inside the tunnel
terrace hero at s=520 seen at 3-8 m: full relief allowed here, spend the peak budget on it
machines instanced per type; panel flicker is emissive only, sequenced, max 6 panels animating at once
howl peak: spire runes + pillar + aurora; aurora is a shader sky layer, not particles; this is the only segment allowed at peak

gate.measuredOn: S20 FE via the daily bench link only
fails: any segment over its drawCalls or visibleTriangles cap
frame time p95 over 20 ms on any segment
more than 1 hitch over 50 ms per minute
thermal throttle step or fps median under 55 during the 30 min loop
texture, geometry or JS heap over budget
audio over voice, memory or CPU caps
near-ring share under 60% at hero points (s=40, 520, 1090)
gate.selfTest: a deliberately over-budget build must FAIL before the gate is trusted

openQuestions: B5 plaza length (Gamify asks 60 m): peak budget holds either way, but a longer plaza means longer time at peak load; the 30 min loop will show heat.
New B1 slabs / B3 gap / B4 gears: if confirmed, count them inside the segment caps above.
